newsitem.title: USA: Iron Mountain files for notes offering.
newsitem.headline: Iron Mountain files for notes offering.

text.p: Iron Mountain Inc, a records management company, said on Wednesday it filed with the Securities and Exchange Commission for the proposed issuance of $150 million of Senior Subordinated Notes due 2006.
Donaldson, Lufkin & Jenrette Securities Corp; Bear, Stearns & Co Inc; and Prudential Securities Inc will be the underwriters for the proposed offering, a statement from Iron Mountain said.
The company said it will use the net proceeds from the offering of the notes to repay debt, to finance possible future acquisitions and for general corporate purposes.
